analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold, rising from 16.3 to 28.9. MACD histogram also improves from -0.0234 to -0.0074, signaling potential bottoming. However, ADX at 38.8 indicates a clear trend, with -DI above +DI suggesting continued downward pressure. Volume ratio of 0.77 (below average) reduces conviction for trend reversal. Support near 52-week low of $0.89 needs confirmation.
